title: Gemini 4 Neon on GraphWalks long-context BFS (F1)

source.statement: 95.2% F1 for GraphWalks BFS in the 256K–1M-token context setting, reported for Gemini 4 Neon.

benchmark.name: GraphWalks
benchmark.version: Official openai/graphwalks public dataset; revision and 200-problem selection not yet pinned
benchmark.reference_population: Google states 200 GraphWalks long-context problems; exact row IDs not independently established

protocol.harness: Source benchmark's grading semantics must be independently pinned
protocol.model_settings: Google reports highest available Gemini API thinking settings
protocol.sampling_and_repeats: Google describes pass@1 except otherwise noted and averages several trials for smaller evaluations; exact GraphWalks trial design not established
protocol.reference_note: Google reports self-computed results on 200 tasks. Full prompt formatting, truncation, output parsing, sampling parameters and data revision need verification.

limitations: No independent Gemini 4 Neon inference or benchmark reproduction has been performed.
The dataset is publicly listed under MIT, while the exact 200 evaluated task IDs and revision used by Google remain unverified.
Model API identifier, token accounting, thinking effort, output parsing, retries and F1 aggregation need confirmation.
Individual prompts contain 256K to 1M tokens, creating substantial usage cost; a short diagnostic subset cannot reproduce the headline result.
The current Model Claim Replay Inspect importer is Chartography-specific; this claim is registered for research and is not executable by that adapter.
